headline: Why Microchip Technology (MCHP) Is Up 14.0% After Strong Q1 Results And New PCIe Gen 6 Push
summary: In early August 2026, Microchip Technology reported first-quarter fiscal 2027 results showing sales rising to US$1,484.7 million and net income improving to US$229.8 million, alongside guidance for higher second-quarter revenue and earnings and a reaffirmed quarterly dividend of US$0.455 per share.
